notes: This is a bounded set of reviewed exclusions, not an exhaustive positive server-side Ritual drop list.
All shared unique artwork and existing catalog labels remain available to inventory recognition and historical records.
Unknown items retain existing recognition behavior; source:null does not mean eligible.
Published Foretold Bounty evidence takes precedence over general acquisition assumptions.
No broad family rule is applied: campaign rewards, named bounties, Queen rewards, currency conversion and Sacred Bloom may extend ordinary endgame offers.
RePoE release_state does not establish active Ritual eligibility.
The full Omen class snapshot includes five Expedition Sagas plus 45 Omen-named records; source presence alone is not an eligibility claim.
